analysis: The PR is documentation-only: docs/developer/test.md gains a 'Deadline Admission Estimators' section (head lines 373-401). It describes synthetic, scripted-engine tests (EngineMeasurementOrderingTests, AdmissionRateEstimatorTests, SDK CBv2PerBatchDecode* suites) and swift test commands. It changes no runtime code, keys, attestation, authorization, cache-storage or WebSocket behavior. I checked it against the threat model: T-041 (prefix cache and SSD tier), TB-002, TB-007, T-010 and T-029 (availability) and the App Attest authorization boundary TB-011. The section only documents estimator and admission-rate test coverage. It explicitly states that no model or GPU runs and that it does not qualify live refusal rates, hardware performance or routing. It adds no new attack surface, such as new env vars, network endpoints or credential handling, and it does not instruct users to disable security controls. The commands are local and isolated, consistent with the file's existing guidance to avoid production state. Residual items for later passes: the doc refers to tests and source (e.g. EngineV2Bridge event pump, admission estimators) that are not in this batch, so whether those implementations match the descriptions is unverified. Any related runtime change in the same PR (deadline admission or rate estimators affecting availability and DoS posture, T-010/T-029) would need its own review. The unchanged remainder of the doc was read for context only, and nothing there is affected by this change.
